0.original: Alphinaud hopes that you are ready to rejoin the main host.

48.original: Because I've got other skills! Need I remind you I'm one of the finest hunters this tribe has ever seen? And speak for yourself! I don't remember you being a master culinarian!

49.original: ...How long has it been since we saw Father? Maybe Alphinaud and I ought to visit Sharlayan.

50.original: So if your mother's food is so good, why are you such a terrible cook? Honestly, you've got to get her to teach you the basics while we're here.

51.original: I trust you are well rested and refreshed, yes? Then let us return to the front.

52.original: The greater part of the Alliance forces should have advanced into the Peaks by now, but I expect we will pass many of our comrades on the road east.

53.original: There is a checkpoint along the way, as I recall, but we will need only to identify ourselves to the soldiers in order to pass.

54.original: Scions! A pleasure to have you with us again.

55.original: You'll be happy to hear we've taken Ala Ghiri, and have already begun fortifying it as our new base of operations in the Peaks. Give a shout to the lads as you pass, eh?

56.original: The imperials sure do like their towers, don't they?

57.original: My village─the one we visited with Meffrid─is far to the north. There's no easy way to get to it from here, though...

58.original: Through the pass and onward to the southeast, was it?

59.original: Well met, Sci─ Wait, where are the rest of you?

60.original: Everything appears to be in order. Very good, very good...

61.original: Enjoy your time with M'naago and her kin? Aye, that's what I want to hear. Too many soldiers forget the importance of time away from all this.

62.original: On behalf of the Elder Seedseer, I thank you for your swift and decisive action against the primal menace. We are not unaware of the danger it posed to our fair nation.

63.original: The imperials underestimated us once, and they paid dearly for it. They may not be so easily deceived next time─but if we cannot fool them, we will simply have to break them!

64.original: As you can see, this part of the Peaks is much higher than the northern reaches, hence why the imperials built Specula Imperatoris where they did.

65.original: See those three towers to the east? That's her. Sits right on the edge of a cliff, so attacking from the north is a fool's errand. From the south, on the other hand, she's no different from any other imperial installation.

66.original: You see now why Velodyna was so important, eh? Right, then. Come along─they're waiting for us in Ala Ghiri.

67.original: The settlement is remarkably intact. I see little evidence of fighting...

68.original: Ala Ghiri's famous for that giant crystal. Some say Rhalgr Himself put it there.

69.original: Ala Ghiri was once a hub of trade and commerce, as I recall, hence the need for a large central square.

70.original: Here we are. The new base of operations for the Alliance and the Resistance!

72.original: Greetings, General. I see you have been quite busy in our absence.

73.original: Less than you may imagine. The imperials fled at our coming, and we took the village without a fight.

74.original: Your timing is impeccable. We were about to discuss our strategy to seize Specula Imperatoris.

75.original: Though we are fresh from the road, we should be glad to attend.

76.original: Good. Take a moment to gather yourselves, and join us when you are ready.
